query: SELECT id AS "id!: ContactId" FROM ((SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE COALESCE(status = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND (id < $3) AND ($3 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE COALESCE(status = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND ($3 IS NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) __ids ORDER BY id DESC
